Bist du schön länger ein Fan von Minecra:

What awaits you:
In the Minecraft modding course you not only learn how mods are made, but also how to develop your own creative mods. Instead of just building in Minecraft, you will create a mod pack with new or modified entities and tools that have completely unique functions.

Your tools:
During the camp you will be introduced to free tools for Minecraft modding. With Blockbench you model your own objects and creatures in a 3D block environment. Then you give them special properties with MCreator. MCreator gives you an insight into visual programming and the basics of coding. You will get to know concepts such as variables, loops and branches.

Your creations:
Create your own or already familiar characters (e.g. Herobrine), unique and legendary weapons (e.g. Thor's hammer) or even unique vehicles. There are no limits to your creativity!

Why you should take part:
• Unfold your creativity: you learn how to turn your ideas into reality.
• Develop programming skills: get a first insight into the world of coding, a skill that is becoming ever more important in today's digital world.
• Have fun and learn: enjoy the combination of playing and learning that will fascinate and motivate you.

Willst du Fotoprofi werden? Eine Woche l:
Do you want to become a photo pro? For a whole week a real photo studio is yours. With big spotlights, colourful lights, wind machines, soap bubbles and crazy props you can experiment creatively and conjure up exciting photos. Every day you learn something new: How does light change your photo? What makes a cool perspective? How do you tell stories with pictures? You train your eye and learn how to handle professional cameras and lenses. Always there too: Charlie, our studio dog. In your own photo learning booklet you collect everything you learn and take it home with you at the end.

In the afternoons we head out and the city becomes your personal photo safari. We visit the costume department of the Opernhaus Zürich: there you see where the costumes for the big stage productions are made, photograph them – and get to know a building that hardly anyone else is allowed to look inside. Another day is all about mobility: we take a look inside a real VBZ tram depot and photograph the trams up close.

Then there are the animals on the farm, close-ups in the Botanical Garden and portraits. You can even approach people in the street who will spontaneously model for you – real street photography. In between we play, laugh a lot and get moving outdoors. So that you are well looked after, there is always one leader for every 5 children.

By the end of the week you are a real photo pro. You present your favourite picture at a proper vernissage for your whole family, with your own diploma.

Whether you already have experience or are just starting out, all children are welcome. And you will meet lots of new people.
Eigene Kamera (Handy oder digitale Kamer: Your own camera (mobile phone or digital camera); if you don't have one, please contact the course leader (verein@fotokids.ch).

How can you improve your flow and find out which vocal range is best for your rapping? Or do you simply want to try something new and find out: how do I write my own raps?
With beatboxing we'll gain experience with the basic technique and imitate simple beats with our mouths. We'll also learn a kind of didgeridoo breathing technique that lets you produce a tone and a beat at the same time!

At the end there's the chance to record the best lines and put them together into a song. You can take this home with you as a memento of the workshop.
Optional: Instrumental-Beat, um darüber:
Optional: an instrumental beat to rap or write over (YouTube link or mp3).
Alternatively, you can choose one of the course leader's instrumentals.

Wir schauen uns die faszinierende Natur:
We'll take a closer look at fascinating nature and observe its inhabitants in order to understand what they need from their habitat. What actually is the difference between Maja the honeybee and Mia the wild bee? And what do they contribute to biodiversity?
We'll look at how we can do nature some good, what each of us can contribute, and together we'll create something great to take home. We'll be accompanied by our dear little sheep, who will be spoiled by us with cuddles and treats.
Vegetarisches Mittagessen, dem Wetter an: Vegetarian lunch, weather-appropriate clothing that is allowed to get dirty, and sturdy, waterproof shoes.
Der Botanische Garten UZH und die Tropen:
The Botanical Garden UZH and the tropical greenhouses turn into a sound studio! What does nature sound like? Which sounds are hidden between and inside the leaves, stems and roots?
Together we set out on sound expeditions, record natural sounds and explore the acoustic diversity of plants and their surroundings. We build our own sound tools, visit researchers at ETH and the University of Zürich and discover the fascinating world of bioacoustics.
You turn the sounds you have collected into your own plant song. Kate Lim (artist & professional musician/DJ) accompanies and coaches you along the way. You don't need any previous knowledge – just curiosity and a love of music.
The songs created will then be presented as part of an exhibition in summer 2027 at the Botanical Garden UZH.
A varied holiday programme that combines art, music and science and opens up a new view of the fascinating world of plants.
Treffpunkt Cafeteria Botanischer Garten: Meeting point: Cafeteria of the Botanical Garden UZH
Zieh mit uns los und entdecke, was direk:
Come along with us and discover what grows right on our doorstep. Together with an experienced plant expert you will get to know edible wild plants and medicinal herbs. You will learn how people have used plants for healing and in everyday life for centuries, and what lies behind the mysterious stories about witches and old customs.

On our discovery tour we collect wild plants, make a fire together and prepare a simple lunch from them. Afterwards you make your own calendula ointment, which of course you can take home with you.
Along the way you will learn exciting things about the animal and plant world, why diversity in nature is so important and how we can protect it.
In diesem abwechslungsreichen Kochkurs e:
In this varied cooking course children discover the joy of cooking and baking.

Together we prepare simple, healthy and tasty dishes, learn how to handle kitchen utensils safely and find out exciting things about food. Teamwork, creativity and, of course, fun are at the heart of it all. At the end we enjoy the delicacies we have made together – and every child takes home new ideas and recipes.

Together we visit the Helvetiaplatz market, discover fresh, seasonal fruit and vegetables and learn what to look out for when shopping. The children can ask questions, choose ingredients and experience where our food comes from.

Sanfte Einführung in den Wassersport, Ke: A gentle introduction to water sports, getting to know stand-up paddling, learning the basic techniques (paddling straight ahead, steering, braking, turning), games on SUP boards, first experience of relays and small competitions, and later further competition and game formats.
Badetuch, Badekleider, Sonnenschutz, Kop: Bring a towel, swimwear, sun protection, headwear and rain protection in wet weather. Warm clothes for afterwards. Stand-up paddle board, paddle, life jacket, team shirt and, if necessary, wetsuit and shoes are provided.
Teilnehmende müssen 100 Meter im tiefen: Participants must be able to swim 100 metres in deep water.
Ein Skate-Kurs speziell für Mädchen und: A skate course especially for girls and young women, led by women. The participants learn the basics such as pushing, carving and braking on the skateboard. Tricks such as an ollie or a drop-in into the mini ramp are also practised.
Wasserflasche, bequeme Kleider, flache,: Water bottle, comfortable clothes, flat, closed trainers (no fabric shoes), your own skateboard, knee pads and helmet if available.
Im Kurs gilt Helmpflicht. Wer keinen Hel: Helmets are compulsory in the course. Anyone who doesn't have a helmet can borrow one. A small snack is included in the course, as is the equipment rental for skates, pads and helmet.
